decisions.reason: Transactional email sending builds directly on the firm's core messaging expertise and data centers, and as the flagship product it is the one where the firm can best read early results and keep improving.

Document capture and recognition extends the firm's electronic document workflows, but it draws on OCR knowledge less central to its messaging base, so there is moderate risk despite the product having its own page.
Email and fax conversion is a natural extension of the firm's long-standing multichannel messaging competence and is easy to integrate and evaluate.
Fax delivery optimization relies on the firm's deep fax-handling know-how and is a low-cost feature, although fax is a declining channel.
Sandbox threat protection strengthens the firm's email security portfolio, an area where it has related knowledge and steady demand from regulated customers.
Multi-engine virus scanning builds on existing email security services and integrates with partner engines, so the firm can absorb and refine it easily.
